encoder.colour_to_channel: colour c drives type index c % channels (fixed rule)
encoder.colour_representation: categorical histogram per column, never averaged
encoder.change_channel: none; motion is left to T4/T5

v1.band: PASS iff pooled per-cell median DSI >= 0.3 (T4 on ON bar, T5 on OFF bar) AND T4a-d distinct preferred directions >= 3 AND T5a-d distinct >= 3 AND defined-DSI fraction >= 0.5; preregistered before the sweep
v1.prior_context: Prior repo measurement at gain 2.0: frame-to-frame T4/T5 pattern change 3.41x larger for a moving than a static bar (2.53x for LC); direction selectivity itself was explicitly not established by that measurement.

v2.band: PASS iff Spearman rho >= 0.5 between object-position distance and 1 - Pearson pattern correlation of LC/LPLC positive activity over 300 position pairs AND valid-pair fraction >= 0.8; preregistered before the sweep
